claims.claim: The paper reports a working web application and usability findings supporting its use as a training aid.
claims.limitations: Small usability sample, task design, browser/audio conditions, and self-report limit claims about long-term learning or clinical outcomes.

claims.claim: The paper reports benchmark results for Vietnamese audio toxic-span detection.
claims.limitations: Dataset construction, annotation agreement, language, ASR errors, and social context bound the result; a benchmark score is not a complete safety policy.

claims.claim: The paper reports improved respiratory-sound classification with the proposed denoising approach.
claims.limitations: Dataset, labels, recording hardware, noise conditions, and evaluation split limit generalization to clinical deployment or diagnosis.

claims.claim: The paper reports comparative forgetting and adaptation results across the tested strategies.
claims.limitations: Tasks, training order, model size, data mixture, and retention metrics bound the conclusions; results do not establish lifelong learning in open deployment.

claims.claim: The paper reports how the analyzed backends behave on the NIST SRE24 evaluation conditions.
claims.limitations: Benchmark protocol, language/channel conditions, calibration, and chosen operating points limit claims beyond SRE24.

claims.claim: The paper reports low-bitrate codec and speaker-decoupling results on its reconstruction/conversion evaluations.
claims.limitations: Bitrate, speaker set, decoder, datasets, and disentanglement tests bound the claim; identity leakage can remain outside the tested conditions.

claims.claim: The paper reports improved contextual-biasing performance for the proposed synthetic-data objective.
claims.limitations: Keyword lists, synthetic-data quality, language, decoder, and evaluation distribution limit generalization; better keyword recall can still create false activations.

claims.claim: The paper reports coordinated acoustic and linguistic findings in Parkinson's speech.
claims.limitations: Cohort, task, disease stage, annotation, and statistical design limit clinical generalization; association is not diagnosis or causation.
